originalSourceText:
Q.4  A KUKA KR 5 robot performs the following repeated motion:

           •  Moves 300 mm horizontally and 200 mm vertically from its initial position
             along a single straight-line path.

           •   Returns to its initial position along the same straight-line path.

           •  Repeats the complete cycle 12 times.

     Assume the robot operates at 60% of  its maximum speed of 8.2 m/s, ignoring
       acceleration and deceleration time. Determine the total distance travelled and the ideal
        total motion time.

      (A) 8.65 m and 1.76 s

      (B) 8.31 m and 1.69 s

      (C) 16.62 m and 3.38 s

      (D) 9.60 m and 1.95 s

       Explanation:

      The one-way distance is 𝑑= √(0.300)2 + (0.200)2 = 0.3606 m

      The robot returns along the same path, so the distance per cycle is:

                                  𝑑cycle = 2(0.3606) = 0.7212 m
      For 12cycles:

                                     𝑑total = 12(0.7212) = 8.65 m
      The operating speed is:

                  𝑣= 0.60(8.2) = 4.92 m/s
       Therefore:

                                       8.65
                       𝑡=   = 1.76 s
                                       4.92
